# Cruxy

> Cruxy is a free time tracking and invoicing app for solo freelancers. Track your time, invoice your clients, and see what you've earned, with no per-seat pricing and no team-tool bloat. Use it on the web at https://get.cruxy.io (add it to your home screen on iPhone or Android). Google Play and App Store versions are coming soon.

## Pricing
- Free: $0. Up to 2 active clients, unlimited projects and tasks, 3 emailed invoices per month, CSV import and export, PDF client statements with your own logo.
- Pro: $4.99 per month, cancel anytime. Unlimited active clients and emailed invoices, project budgets with monthly rollover, retainers, invoices without the Cruxy footer.

## What it does
- Timer and manual entries, with a rate per client, optional per project, and overridable per entry.
- Invoices from unbilled time: PDF, emailed from the app, with tax, rounding, your logo, and sent/paid/overdue status. Cruxy does not process client payments.
- Retainers and project budgets in hours (Pro).
- Optional daily email reminder to log time, sent only if no time was logged that day.
- Free CSV import from Clockify, Toggl and Harvest; CSV export; works offline for logging time.

## Help Center (step-by-step guides)
- [Get started](https://cruxy.io/support/get-started/): Cruxy tracks your time and turns it into invoices. Setup takes about five minutes.
- [Logging time](https://cruxy.io/support/time/): Track time with the timer, add it by hand, or fill in a weekly timesheet.
- [Clients and projects](https://cruxy.io/support/clients-projects/): Clients and projects organize your time and decide what you charge.
- [Invoices](https://cruxy.io/support/invoices/): Turn your unbilled time into a PDF invoice and send it from the app.
- [Alerts](https://cruxy.io/support/alerts/): Cruxy can nudge you to log time, tell you when an invoice is overdue, and on Pro remind your clients for you.
- [Budgets and retainers](https://cruxy.io/support/budgets-retainers/): Project budgets and retainers are Pro features. They help you stay on scope and bill recurring work.
- [Free vs Pro](https://cruxy.io/support/free-vs-pro/): Free covers time tracking and invoicing for up to 2 active clients. Pro is $4.99 a month for everything else.
- [Billing](https://cruxy.io/support/billing/): Cruxy Pro is $4.99 a month. On the web, payments are handled by Stripe. In the Android app, they go through Google Play.
- [Account](https://cruxy.io/support/account/): Your profile, how you sign in, and how to leave.
- [Troubleshooting](https://cruxy.io/support/troubleshooting/): Quick answers to the problems people run into most.
- [Contact us](https://cruxy.io/support/contact/): Email us and you'll get a quick response from a real person.
- [Help Center home](https://cruxy.io/support/): search and browse every topic
- [All support articles as one text file](https://cruxy.io/llms-full.txt)
- Support email: support@cruxy.io (a real person replies quickly)
